title: Verification entry
description: One entry of the evidence-verifier agent's output. The CLI also accepts the camelCase spelling of every field name (candidateId, evidenceQuality, technicalConfidence, fixVerdict, fixConfidence, fixReason, fixDirection, impactTraced, premisesVerified, requiredContextMissing). Keep the checks in `verificationProblem` in src/cli.ts in step with this file.

premises_verified.description: For a question: whether the facts it rests on hold. A question is eligible without a verified answer, but not when this is false.

required_context_missing.description: Context the verifier needed and could not obtain. A string, or an object without `kind`, is blocking: the claim depends on it and cannot ship. `cosmetic` context would only sharpen the wording, and does not hold the claim back.
